name: Maskwood Nexus and Arcane Adaptation give their types to graveyard cards a count reads
notes: Conor, 2026-11-22: "creature cards you own that aren't on the battlefield" have the type a count of graveyard cards reads. Cid, Timeless Artificer: +1/+1 for each Artificer you control and each Artificer card in your graveyard. Maskwood Nexus: Cid and Grizzly Bears are every creature type (Artificers, and Heroes, so both get it), and the Craw Wurm card in your graveyard is an Artificer card; the opponent's Hill Giant card is not yours. 2 + 1 = 3: Bears 5/5, Cid 7/7. The opponent's Arcane Adaptation, Artificer chosen: their Cid and Ornithopter are Artificers, and their Hill Giant card is an Artificer card (Craw Wurm, yours, is not theirs): 2 + 1 = 3, Ornithopter 3/5.
